description: Retained actual hosted-model runtime events on sample tasks, wrapped in new local inter-agent replay envelopes. Not production network captures.

measurement.baseline: Compact UTF-8 JSON array of exactly the same full envelopes.
measurement.timing_scope: Local validated encode/decode; excludes source I/O, SQLite, network and batch accumulation time. Median of repeats; machine-dependent.
measurement.wire_scope: Payload bytes including shared context and annotations; excludes transport headers. Content type is required for either format.
limitations: Binary wire savings are not LLM token, cost, latency or energy savings.
Batching can delay first-event delivery; choose flush thresholds for the workload.
Base64 adds bytes: the export is inspectable JSON, not the measured binary wire.
Each batch is independently decodable; no hidden context setup is excluded.
Batch codec and mailbox are opt-in primitives, not automatic runtime networking.

scenarios.name: Dense float fallback
scenarios.detail: Float64 is preserved exactly; compact JSON is smaller for this payload.

scenarios.name: Policy context refresh
scenarios.detail: A fresh receiver decodes policy v2 and new actor without receiving v1.

scenarios.name: Wrong tenant / truncated frame
scenarios.detail: Both malformed or wrong-scope deliveries are rejected before mailbox insertion.

mailbox.timing_scope: One local sample per path on separate fresh SQLite databases; FULL synchronous WAL, validation and commits included. Frame construction, database creation and acknowledgements excluded. Not a production throughput or network-latency benchmark.
